items: 【Say Goodbye to Burden, Travel Lighter】This ultralight tote bag is more than half the weight of a traditional leather laptop bag. Whether for daily commutes, business trips, or mobile work, it's your reliable, lightweight companion.

items.label: 【Sturdy and Resilient, Clear View】
items.value: The built-in frame design ensures the bag remains upright and stylish even when empty. Combined with a wide rectangular opening, the contents are clearly visible, allowing for quick access and helping you maintain a composed and professional image in any situation.

items.label: 【More Than Just Size, More Than Order】
items.value: With a massive 25-liter capacity, it achieves intelligent organization through 13 cleverly designed pockets. Your 15.6-inch laptop and 12.9-inch iPad are protected by dedicated padded compartments, while other items can be easily categorized. Whether it's your commuting gear or travel luggage, everything is neatly organized and readily available.

items: 【Designed for large tote cups】 The interior pocket easily accommodates a 40-ounce Stanley water bottle. Say goodbye to worries about whether it will fit. The exterior front pocket and top zippered quick-access pocket keep your essentials within easy reach.

items.label: 【Durable and waterproof】
items.value: Made with LOVEVOOK high-performance composite fabric, it has excellent wear resistance, scratch resistance and waterproof properties.
